title: Red alert Oct 28: Khammam, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Mulugu as cyclone nears Andhra coast
body: The storm, set to be named Arnab, may cross the coast between Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam on Oct 28. East Telangana gets the heavy rain; Hyderabad stays dry till Oct 27.

steps.b: IMD put 3 east Telangana districts on red alert for Oct 28.
A Bay of Bengal storm is strengthening and heading for the Andhra coast.
Expected to become a cyclone by Oct 26. We'll update if Hyderabad gets an alert.

care: Travel to Khammam or Bhadrachalam on Oct 27–28? Push it if you can.
